xmlsec = { pkg-path = "xmlsec", version = "1.3.7" }
freetds = { pkg-path = "freetds" } # For pymssql

# Set a lower priority on corepack so it takes precedence over nodejs (both bundle pnpm)
# https://flox.dev/docs/man/manifest.toml/#catalog-descriptors

POSTHOG_SKIP_MIGRATION_CHECKS = "1"

[hook]
on-activate = '''

[profile]
bash = '''
  if [ -f "$HOME/.bash_profile" ]; then
    source "$HOME/.bash_profile"

  export GOCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"
  export GOMODCACHE="$GOPATH/pkg/mod"

  # uv venv path — set here, not in [vars] (which can't expand $FLOX_ENV_CACHE)
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"

    uv sync

  elif [ ! -L "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ] || [ ! -e "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ]; then
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  fi
  source $UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate
  # Source hogli bash completions
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/completions/hogli.bash" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/completions/hogli.bash"
  # Load phw worktree helper
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" >/dev/null
  # Route manually-run dependency installs (uv sync, pnpm install, ...) through the dev sandbox on macOS

  # uv venv path — set here, not in [vars] (which can't expand $FLOX_ENV_CACHE)
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  # Recreate venv if it was deleted (on-activate only runs on first activation)
  if [[ ! -f "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate" ]]; then
    uv sync
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  elif [[ ! -L "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ]] || [[ ! -e "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ]]; then
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  fi
  source $UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate
  # Add hogli completions to zsh
  [[ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/completions/_hogli" ]] && fpath=("$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/completions" $fpath)
  autoload -Uz compinit && compinit -i
  # Load phw worktree helper
  [[ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" ]] && source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" >/dev/null
  # Route manually-run dependency installs (uv sync, pnpm install, ...) through the dev sandbox on macOS
  [[ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/dev-sandbox-shims" ]] && source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/dev-sandbox-shims"

  set -gx GOCACHE "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"

schema-version = "1.13.0"

[install]
# --- Python: the primary runtime. pyproject.toml pins requires-python == 3.13.13
# exactly ("Pin full version to control Python upgrades explicitly"), and the
# catalog carries that exact build on all four systems.

python313.version = "python3-3.13.13"
python313.pkg-group = "python"
uv.pkg-path = "uv"
uv.pkg-group = "uv"

# --- Node: .nvmrc v24.13.0, package.json engines.node ">=24 <25".
# pnpm 10.29.3 comes from corepack (bundled in nodejs_24) reading the
# packageManager field — the catalog's pnpm_10 has 10.29.2, not .3.
nodejs_24.pkg-path = "nodejs_24"
nodejs_24.version = "24.13.0"
nodejs_24.pkg-group = "nodejs"

# --- Go: `go 1.25.5` in livestream/, tools/phrocs/, bin/hobby-installer/
go_1_25.pkg-path = "go_1_25"
go_1_25.version = "1.25.5"
go_1_25.pkg-group = "go"

# --- Rust: the rust/ workspace (capture, feature-flags, property-defs-rs, ...)
cargo.pkg-path = "cargo"
cargo.pkg-group = "rust-toolchain"
rustc.pkg-path = "rustc"
rustc.pkg-group = "rust-toolchain"
clippy.pkg-path = "clippy"
clippy.pkg-group = "rust-toolchain"
rustfmt.pkg-path = "rustfmt"
rustfmt.pkg-group = "rust-toolchain"

# --- Datastores, served as Flox services below.
# postgres:15.12-alpine and redis:7.2-alpine per docker-compose.base.yml.
postgresql_15.pkg-path = "postgresql_15"
postgresql_15.version = "15.12"
postgresql_15.pkg-group = "postgres"
redis.pkg-path = "redis"
redis.version = "7.2.7"
redis.pkg-group = "redis"

# --- Native build inputs for Python C extensions.
# `out` is NOT a default output on openssl/libxml2/libxslt (only bin/man are),
# so the shared libs these link against are absent unless listed explicitly.
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"
openssl.pkg-path = "openssl"
openssl.outputs = ["bin", "dev", "out"]
libxml2.pkg-path = "libxml2"          # lxml==6.0.2, xmlsec
libxml2.outputs = ["bin", "dev", "out"]
libxslt.pkg-path = "libxslt"          # lxml==6.0.2, xmlsec
libxslt.outputs = ["bin", "dev", "out"]
xmlsec.pkg-path = "xmlsec"            # xmlsec==1.3.17 (SAML)
xmlsec.outputs = ["out", "dev"]
freetds.pkg-path = "freetds"          # pymssql==2.3.5

# --- ClickHouse / Kafka / Zookeeper stay on docker-compose (see [hook]).
docker-compose.pkg-path = "docker-compose"

[vars]
DEBUG = "1"

# Postgres — posthog/settings/data_stores.py defaults PGHOST to the compose
# hostname "db"; point it at the Flox service instead.
PGHOST = "127.0.0.1"
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "posthog"
PGPASSWORD = "posthog"
PGDATABASE = "posthog"
DATABASE_URL = "postgres://posthog:posthog@127.0.0.1:5432/posthog"

# Redis — settings default is "redis://redis7/" (the compose hostname).

REDIS_PORT = "6379"

# ClickHouse — served by docker-compose. CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE defaults to

CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE = "posthog"
CLICKHOUSE_USER = "default"
CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD = ""

[hook]
on-activate = '''
  # --- Python (uv workspace; uv.lock present)
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  uv sync --frozen >&2

  # --- Node / pnpm 10.29.3 via corepack, into a writable dir

  export COREPACK_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/corepack"
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin"
  corepack enable --install-directory "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin" pnpm >&2 2>/dev/null || true
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"

  # --- Go
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export GOCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"
  export GOMODCACHE="$GOPATH/pkg/mod"
  export GOTOOLCHAIN=local

  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/target"
  mkdir -p "$CARGO_HOME" "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"

  # --- Postgres cluster (first activation only)

      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2

    createdb -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE"

[vars]
# Postgres — matches docker-compose.base.yml's db service credentials so
# DATABASE_URL from .env.services works unchanged.
PGUSER = "posthog"
PGPASSWORD = "posthog"
PGDATABASE = "posthog"
PGPORT = "5432"
PGHOST = "127.0.0.1"
REDIS_PORT = "6379"
# ← .env.development
DEBUG = "1"

# Build flags for the native Python/Rust extensions above.

[hook]
on-activate = '''
  # ── Rust / Go / uv caches live outside the repo tree ──
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo-target"
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export GOCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"
  export GOMODCACHE="$GOPATH/pkg/mod"
  export SCCACHE_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/sccache"
  mkdir -p "$CARGO_HOME" "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR" "$GOPATH" "$GOCACHE" "$GOMODCACHE" "$SCCACHE_DIR"

  # bindgen (rdkafka-sys, librocksdb-sys) needs libclang at an explicit path.
  export LIBCLANG_PATH="$FLOX_ENV/lib"

  # ── Postgres cluster ── ported from docker-compose.base.yml's db service and
  # the docker/postgres-init-scripts/*.sh init mount (which docker-compose runs
  # via /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d).
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    echo "Initialising PostgreSQL cluster (first activation)..." >&2
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" --username="$PGUSER" --auth=trust --no-locale --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -o "-p $PGPORT -k /tmp" -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start >&2
    until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -q; do sleep 0.2; done

    # Databases created by docker/postgres-init-scripts/*.sh
    for db in posthog agent_runtime_queue behavioral_cohorts cyclotron \
              cyclotron_node ducklake flags_read_store posthog_persons test_dagster; do
      createdb -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$db" 2>/dev/null || true
    done

    # Per-product databases — same derivation as create-product-dbs.sh:
    # unique `database:` values in products/db_routing.yaml, prefixed posthog_
    if [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/products/db_routing.yaml" ]; then
      awk -F': ' '/^[[:space:]]*database:/{print $2}' "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/products/db_routing.yaml" \
        | tr -d "\"'" | sort -u | while read -r name; do
          case "$name" in ''|*[!a-z0-9_]*) continue ;; esac
          createdb -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "posthog_${name}" 2>/dev/null || true
        done
    fi

    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast >&2
  fi

  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/redis"

  # ── Python deps ──
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  export UV_PYTHON="$FLOX_ENV/bin/python3.13"
  uv sync --frozen >&2

  # ── Node deps ── pnpm@10.29.3 exactly, as pinned by package.json packageManager.
  export COREPACK_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/corepack"
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin"
  corepack enable --install-directory "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin" pnpm >&2 2>/dev/null || true
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"
  pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >&2

  # ── Services Flox does not serve ── ClickHouse mounts server config and
  # depends on Kafka/Zookeeper, so it stays under docker-compose.
  if command -v docker >/dev/null && docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    docker-compose -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/docker-compose.dev.yml" up -d \
      zookeeper kafka clickhouse 2>&1 | tail -5 >&2
  else
    echo "⚠  Docker not running — ClickHouse/Kafka/Zookeeper not started." >&2
    echo "   Start Docker, then: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d zookeeper kafka clickhouse" >&2
  fi
'''

[profile]
bash = '''
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo-target"
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"

  [ -f "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate" ] && source "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate"
'''

fish = '''
  set -gx CARGO_HOME "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  set -gx CARGO_TARGET_DIR "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo-target"
  set -gx GOPATH "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  set -gx GOCACHE "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"
  set -gx GOMODCACHE "$GOPATH/pkg/mod"
  fish_add_path -g "$CARGO_HOME/bin" "$GOPATH/bin" "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin"
  set -gx UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  set -gx PGDATA "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  test -f "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate.fish" && source "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate.fish"
'''

[services.postgres]
command = '''
  exec postgres -D "$PGDATA" -p "$PGPORT" -k /tmp -c listen_addresses="$PGHOST"
'''

[services.redis]
command = '''
  exec redis-server --port "$REDIS_PORT" --dir "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/redis" \
    --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru --maxmemory 200mb --save "" --appendonly no
'''
